mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id, r.service_id, r.reservation_start, r.status, r.request_memo, r.calendar_event_id, r.created_at, u.name AS user_name, u.phone AS user_phone, s.name AS service_name, s.price AS service_price, s.duration_minutes
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reservation r INNER JOIN user_account u ON u.id = r.user_id INNER JOIN service_item s ON s.id = r.service_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.reservation_start DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (user_id, service_id, reservation_start, status, request_memo) VALUES (#{userId}, #{serviceId}, #{reservationStart}, #{status}, #{requestMemo})
